Name: Valley Girls Addon - Nude Farmer and Swimsuits
Author: fomball
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This mod changes the dialogue, portraits, and sprites of the male sex cutscenes in Valley Girls to instead have a nice dose of girlcock! Perfect for if you’re playing a transfem or futa character.


The sprites are meant to be mirror the ones from Nude Farmer and Swimsuits by simezi21. While you don’t need that mod for the cutscenes to work, you will want to download it if you’d like to have the sprites in the overworld.


Thank you to both TrashRacc1124 and simezi21 for their work on Valley Girls and Nude Farmer and Swimsuits, this would obviously not exist without them. Check them out below! (You will also need to look at the valley girls page for a description on how the other features of the mod work)


Valley Girls by TrashRacc1124: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532[/url]
Nude Farmer and Swimsuits by simezi21: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5029]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5029[/url]


If you want gender-neutral or feminine dialogue for the male character in the rest of the game, it is recommended you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.coGender/]Gender[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722] Neutrality Mod[/url].
